name: Verdunville
source:
Play as Vint, a 23-year old student at the University of Verdunville. He doesn't have much going on, but at least he has a couple of friends and a pretty girlfriend, not to mention living in the beautiful European-like city of Verdunville itself.

With a little boredom seeping in after 2 years of studying in the business major, and the routine of his restaurant job, he becomes a little curious to meet other people around campus. You can check out who these people are and decide for yourself whether you want to meet them, or go on with your steady life. Maybe succeeding your dad as CEO of his company isn't such a bad idea after all?

[From [url=https://pantophon.itch.io/verdunville-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演Vint，一名23岁的凡尔登维尔大学学生。他没有太多事情发生，但至少他有几个朋友和一个漂亮的女朋友，更不用说住在美丽的欧洲城市凡尔登维尔本身了。

经过两年的商科专业学习和餐厅工作的例行公事，他渐渐感到有点无聊，他开始对校园里的其他人感到有点好奇。你可以看看这些人是谁，然后自己决定是否要见他们，还是继续你稳定的生活。也许接替你父亲担任他公司的首席执行官毕竟不是一个坏主意？

[来自[url=https://pantophon.itch.io/verdunville-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
